clips.stepText: Start with the accounting equation. Assets equal liabilities plus equity.

clips.stepText: Subtract the investing outflow of eighty thousand from the operating inflow of one hundred and fifty thousand.

clips.stepText: Fifty thousand divided by five is ten thousand, times three gives thirty thousand naira.

clips.stepText: One hundred and twenty thousand minus twenty thousand gives one hundred thousand naira.

clips.stepText: Find twenty percent of the five naira nominal value. That gives a one naira premium per share.
